cases.heading: False or Misleading Risk Presentation
cases.claim: The post, titled “Slynd® (drospirenone),” presents claims and representations about the benefits of Slynd but fails to communicate any risk information.
cases.check: Rule: any branded benefit claim requires risk information in the same piece.

cases.heading: False or Misleading Claims about Efficacy
cases.claim: “Offer your patients estrogen-free birth control with periods on a schedule.”
cases.context: Scheduled bleeding fell from 81.2%/98.0% (Cycle 1) to 26.4%/28.4% (Cycle 13); 40.3%/52.2% unscheduled bleeding at Cycle 13.
cases.rationale: Most patients did not have scheduled periods over time.
cases.check: Does a predictability/regularity claim reflect the long-term (not first-cycle) data in the label?

cases.cat: Failure to submit at time of initial dissemination (Form FDA 2253)
cases.heading: Failure to Submit Under Form FDA-2253
cases.claim: A copy of the post was not submitted to OPDP under cover of Form FDA-2253 at the time of initial publication.
cases.check: Rule: confirm Form FDA 2253 submission at first use.
